_comment: Generated by tools/make_municipality_pack.py from two sources: the デジタル庁 アドレス・ベース・レジストリ prefecture master (PDL 1.0; the committed source extract is packs/mt_pref_all.csv) and the 総務省 local-government code list, 全国地方公共団体コード R6.1.1 = 2024-01-01 (the committed source extract is packs/soumu_city_r611.csv).  jp-prefecture-name comes from the prefecture master, jp-municipality-name from the 総務省 list, and the two code rules merge both sources.  Source and attribution: packs/README.md.  Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
